proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ X Y hX hY
  constructor
  · intro h x y
    have := ((ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun_iff_Indep X Y P).mp h)
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.Indep_iff] at this
    have h1 := this (X ⁻¹' Set.Iic x) (Y ⁻¹' Set.Iic y) ⟨_, measurableSet_Iic, rfl⟩ ⟨_, measurableSet_Iic, rfl⟩
    have h1' : P {ω | X ω ≤ x ∧ Y ω ≤ y} = P {ω | X ω ≤ x} * P {ω | Y ω ≤ y} := h1
    simp only [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
    rw [← ENNReal.toReal_mul, h1']
  · intro h
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun_iff_Indep]
    have eX : MeasurableSpace.comap X inferInstance = MeasurableSpace.generateFrom {s | ∃ x, s = X ⁻¹' Set.Iic x} := by
      rw [BorelSpace.measurable_eq (α := ℝ), borel_eq_generateFrom_Iic, MeasurableSpace.comap_generateFrom]
      congr 1
      ext s; constructor
      · rintro ⟨t, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    have eY : MeasurableSpace.comap Y inferInstance = MeasurableSpace.generateFrom {s | ∃ x, s = Y ⁻¹' Set.Iic x} := by
      rw [BorelSpace.measurable_eq (α := ℝ), borel_eq_generateFrom_Iic, MeasurableSpace.comap_generateFrom]
      congr 1
      ext s; constructor
      · rintro ⟨t, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩; exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    have hpi : ∀ Z : Ω → ℝ, IsPiSystem {s | ∃ x, s = Z ⁻¹' Set.Iic x} := by
      rintro Z _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, rfl⟩ _
      refine ⟨min x y, ?_⟩
      ext ω; simp
    rw [eX, eY]
    refine ProbabilityTheory.IndepSets.indep' ?_ ?_ (hpi X) (hpi Y) ?_
    · rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact hX measurableSet_Iic
    · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩; exact hY measurableSet_Iic
    · rw [ProbabilityTheory.IndepSets_iff]
      rintro _ _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ ⟨y, rfl⟩
      have := h x y
      simp only [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def] at this
      rw [← ENNReal.toReal_mul] at this
      exact (ENNReal.toReal_eq_toReal_iff' (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _) (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _) (MeasureTheory.measure_ne_top _ _))).mp this
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X Y : Ω → ℝ), Measurable X → Measurable Y → (ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X Y P ↔ ∀ x y : ℝ, P.real {ω | X ω ≤ x ∧ Y ω ≤ y} = P.real {ω | X ω ≤ x} * P.real {ω | Y ω ≤ y})
